title: Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
subtitle: Automated Recruitment & Candidate Pipeline Platform
description: A full-stack, automated Applicant Tracking System built to streamline recruitment operations, featuring real-time data sync, AI-assisted screening, automated workflow pipelines, and team collaboration integrations.
longDescription:
Developed as an internal recruitment platform for Devotion Ventures, this Applicant Tracking System (ATS) was designed to automate and streamline the end-to-end candidate intake and evaluation process.

The application is architected as a modern, reactive full-stack web system using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Convex as the real-time cloud database and backend service. It coordinates a multi-stage candidate lifecycle from initial application through screening, conversational assessment, technical review, and final evaluation.

Key architectural capabilities include scheduled background jobs for application synchronization, conversational AI integrations for candidate assessment, automated SLA monitoring to maintain responsive communication, and a human-in-the-loop review queue for outgoing correspondence.

Note: As this is a private internal enterprise tool, the source repository, internal endpoints, and live dashboards are proprietary to Devotion Ventures and are not publicly accessible.
highlights: Engineered a multi-stage candidate management pipeline with real-time status updates
Built reactive cloud backend services and scheduled background jobs using Convex
Integrated AI-assisted evaluation workflows for candidate screening and assessment
Implemented automated communication queues with human-in-the-loop approval mechanisms
Integrated team notification channels for automated alerts and SLA tracking
Developed a responsive, accessible administrative dashboard using React, TypeScript, and modern component systems
